api_collection.response_retention: retain each schema-qualified target-unread raw response byte-for-byte with SHA-256, requested URL, and redirect/final URL; reject target-bearing or malformed responses before persistence
api_collection.failure_policy: no in-place retry: the first transport, schema, or bound-input failure is sealed in a no-clobber failure receipt; any recovery requires a separately named plan and output

deposited_ph_validation.type_normalization: case-insensitive after removing whitespace; only pH is a pH record
deposited_ph_validation.value: finite scalar only; invalid or missing values HOLD

future_consumer_declaration.method: OpenMM 8.6 Modeller.addHydrogens using the deposited pH selected by this catalog
preconditions: a complete feasible pH catalog for all 135 entities
independent coordinate, physicality, provenance, and exact-nesting gates

evidence_trust_boundary: the producer receipt and raw-response manifest are local consistency evidence only; neither PASS nor HOLD is immutable until a separately named archive and execution receipt are exact-hash-bound by the parent plan and replayed by an independently committed checker

linkage_policy.direct_fallback: only when Chem_shift_experiment has no rows or every row has both Experiment_ID and Assigned_chem_shift_list_ID missing; require exactly one valid Assigned_chem_shift_list ID and condition pointer
linkage_policy.exact_route: Chem_shift_experiment.Experiment_ID to Experiment.ID; all complete links must resolve through Experiment.Sample_condition_list_ID to exactly one Assigned_chem_shift_list ID, one condition-list pointer, and one deposited pH; the fetched assigned-list category must contain exactly one selected-list row with the same valid condition pointer
linkage_policy.malformed_partial_link: a Chem_shift_experiment row with only one valid Experiment_ID or Assigned_chem_shift_list_ID is HOLD
linkage_policy.missing_or_ambiguous_entity: semantic metadata absence or ambiguity is per-entity HOLD; malformed response schema, transport failure, or bound-input drift is a whole-run failure

metadata_scope: target-unread metadata feasibility only; no coordinate construction, target inspection, score inspection, authorization consumption, or OpenMM execution
temperature_and_ionic_strength: may be retained as non-gating diagnostics only
warnings: This heuristic is not a pKa calculation.
This heuristic is not a protonation ensemble calculation.
This heuristic does not establish temperature or ionic physicality.
